gmailReadPermission: Read and search Gmail messages you ask Kun to use (gmail.readonly).
gmailApprovalRequired: Before sending, Kun shows the complete recipients, subject and message for your approval.
gmailLocalCredentials: OAuth credentials are encrypted locally. Google sign-in to Kun does not connect Gmail.
gmailModelRestricted: Email processing currently requires Kun’s verified local Ollama model with cloud disabled and routing and failover disabled. Cloud and user-configured localhost providers cannot receive this email data.
gmailLocalDownloadDetails: Downloads qwen3:4b (about 2.5 GB) if needed. It runs locally with cloud disabled; no model API key is required.
gmailLocalPreparing: Preparing the local model. You can keep Kun open while it downloads.
gmailLocalPrepareFailed: The local model is not ready. Refresh or retry preparation.
gmailLocalChooseNewTask: The local model is ready. This task retains its original model; start a new conversation using Kun Gmail Local / qwen3:4b from the normal model picker.
gmailSharingConsent: Allow the approved model shown here to process email data I request in this conversation.
gmailSharingDetails: This includes headers, snippets and plain-text bodies used for search, summaries or replies. The verified model processes them on this computer, with cloud features disabled. Chat and operational records may remain in protected local storage. If you enable paired-device remote access, this conversation can be viewed on your authenticated paired device through your selected connection or tunnel and its transport service. Gmail OAuth credentials are never sent to the remote device. IM bridges do not receive Gmail conversations.
gmailSharingScope: Off by default and limited to this private conversation. Connecting without this permission does not let the agent read email. Other conversations require their own permission.
gmailPrivacy: Gmail data use and privacy policy
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured in this app. Contact the administrator or update Kun.
gmailReconnectRequired: Your Google access has expired or was revoked. Connect Gmail again.
gmailWaiting: Complete Google authorization in your system browser, then return to Kun.
gmailStatusFailed: Could not check Gmail access. Refresh and try again.
gmailCancelled: Authorization cancelled. You can reconnect when ready.
gmailExpired: This authorization attempt expired. Start a new one.
gmailAuthorizationFailed: Google authorization was not completed. Check the permissions and try again.
gmailPollFailed: Could not check authorization. Use Refresh or cancel and retry.
gmailActionFailed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
gmailGrantRequired: Connect Gmail and allow model sharing for this conversation before continuing.
gmailDisconnectDetails: Disconnecting deletes local Gmail credentials and all conversation grants. Existing chat history remains until you delete it.
gmailRevokeWarning: Google revocation can remove grants for other Kun OAuth clients in this Google project, including Google sign-in. You may need to authorize those clients again. Existing local chat history will remain.
gmailReady: Gmail is available to this conversation
